text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play in the garden with her red ball. One day, the ball rolled under a big tree. Lily was sad because she could not reach it. Then her friend Tom came to help. He was tall, so he got the ball for her. Lily was very happy. She said, "Thank you, Tom!" They played together all day until the sun went down.

Max was a small brown dog. He lived in a house with a blue door. Every morning, Max went for a walk with his mom. They walked to the park and saw many birds. One day, Max saw a cat in a tree. He barked and barked. The cat looked down at him and did not move. Max was tired, so he sat down. Soon the cat came down and they became friends.

Sam had a new toy boat. He wanted to see if it could float. He went to the pond with his dad. Sam put the boat in the water. It went up and down on the little waves. "Look, Dad, it floats!" said Sam. His dad smiled and clapped. Then the wind blew the boat away. Sam ran along the side of the pond and got it back. He was proud of his boat.

There was a big green frog who lived by a pond. The frog liked to jump from rock to rock. One day, he jumped too far and fell into the mud. He was all dirty and sad. A kind duck saw him and said, "Come and swim with me." The frog swam in the clean water with the duck. Soon he was clean again. The frog thanked the duck, and they swam together every day.

Mia loved to bake with her grandma. One morning, they made cookies in the kitchen. Mia put the flour and sugar in a bowl. Grandma added eggs and butter. They mixed it all up. Then they put the cookies in the hot oven. The kitchen smelled so good. When the cookies were ready, Mia gave one to her brother. He said it was the best cookie he ever had.

Ben found a shiny rock on the way to school. It was round and smooth and it sparkled in the sun. He put it in his pocket. At school, he showed it to his teacher. She said it was a special rock from the river. Ben was excited. After school, he went home and put the rock on his window. Every night, he looked at it before he went to sleep.

It was a rainy day, and Anna could not go outside. She felt bored. Her mom gave her some paper and crayons. Anna drew a big yellow sun and a rainbow. Then she drew her cat, her house and a tall tree. When the rain stopped, she looked out of the window. There was a real rainbow in the sky! Anna laughed and showed her mom.

A little bird lost its way in the forest. It flew from tree to tree, but it could not find its nest. The bird was scared. Then an old owl spoke to it. "Do not be afraid," said the owl. "Your nest is near the river." The little bird flew to the river and saw its mom and dad. They were so glad to see it. The bird learned to always stay close to home.

Tim and his sister Sue went to the beach. They wanted to build a sand castle. Tim dug a big hole and Sue filled a bucket with water. They made tall walls and a little door. A wave came and broke one wall, but they did not give up. They built it again, even better. At the end of the day, their castle was the best one on the beach.

Lucy had a bad day. She fell down and hurt her knee. Her friend Jack saw that she was crying. He sat next to her and gave her a hug. "It will be okay," he said. Jack told her a funny story about a pig who wanted to fly. Lucy started to laugh. Soon her knee did not hurt so much. She was glad to have a good friend like Jack.

The moon was big and bright. Leo could not sleep, so he looked out of his window. He saw the stars and wished he could fly up to them. His dad came in and sat on the bed. They talked about the sky, the stars and the planets. Dad said that one day Leo could learn all about them. Leo smiled, closed his eyes and fell asleep.

Rosa wanted to grow a flower. She put a small seed in a pot with soil. Every day, she gave it water and put it in the sun. At first, nothing happened. Rosa waited and waited. Then one morning, she saw a tiny green leaf. She was so happy! The plant grew taller and taller. After many days, a pretty pink flower opened. Rosa learned that good things take time.
